    - heading "Integration by Parts" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Use the product rule d(uv)=u(dv)+v(du) to evaluate integrals of products.
    - text: Class 12 Advanced Concept Worked Examples Practice
    - heading "FROM PRODUCT RULE TO INTEGRATION BY PARTS" [level=3]
    - article:
      - text: Product rule
      - heading "d(uv) = u dv + v du" [level=2]
    - strong: →
    - article:
      - text: Rearrange and integrate
      - heading "∫u dv = uv − ∫v du" [level=2]
    - complementary:
      - text: Remember
      - list:
        - listitem: Choose u and dv
        - listitem: Find du and v
        - listitem: Apply formula
        - listitem: Simplify
    - 'heading "EXPLORE: DECISION WORKSPACE" [level=3]'

    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - button "New example"

      - heading "1 Assign u and dv (drag or click)" [level=4]

      - button "x"

      - heading "∫u dv = uv − ∫v du" [level=2]
      - heading "∫ x eˣ dx = x(eˣ) − ∫ eˣ dx" [level=2]
      - separator
      - heading "4 Evaluate the remaining integral" [level=4]
      - paragraph: ∫ eˣ dx is evaluated directly.
      - text: ∫ x eˣ dx = eˣ(x − 1) + C
      - img
    - complementary:
      - 'heading "LIATE: How to choose" [level=3]'
      - button "L"
      - button "I"
      - button "A"
      - button "T"
      - button "E"
      - paragraph: "L: Logarithmic expressions usually become simpler when differentiated."
      - text: "Goal: Differentiate u to make it simpler; integrate dv to get v."
      - heading "COMMON DERIVATIVES AND INTEGRALS" [level=3]
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Expression du ∫ dv":
            - columnheader "Expression"
            - columnheader "du"
            - columnheader "∫ dv"

            - cell "nxⁿ⁻¹ dx"
            - cell "xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)"
          - row "ln x dx/x x ln x−x":
            - cell "ln x"
            - cell "dx/x"
            - cell "x ln x−x"
          - row "eˣ eˣ dx eˣ+C":
            - cell "eˣ"
            - cell "eˣ dx"
            - cell "eˣ+C"
          - row "sin x cos x dx −cos x+C":

            - cell "−cos x+C"
          - row "cos x −sin x dx sin x+C":
            - cell "cos x"
            - cell "−sin x dx"
            - cell "sin x+C"
    - heading "VERIFY YOUR ANSWER" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Differentiate the result to check.
    - heading "F(x) = eˣ(x−1)+C" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: F′(x)=eˣ(x−1)+eˣ = xeˣ
      - img
      - text: Matches the integrand.
    - article:

    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Evaluate ∫x ln x dx.
      - list:
        - listitem: Choose u=ln x and dv=x dx.
        - listitem: Then du=dx/x and v=x²/2.
        - listitem: Apply ∫u dv=uv−∫v du.
        - listitem: Simplify to x²ln(x)/2−x²/4+C.
      - text: ∫x ln x dx = x²ln(x)/2 − x²/4 + C
      - img

      - heading "COMMON MISTAKES" [level=3]
      - paragraph:

        - text: Do not differentiate dv; integrate it to find v.
      - paragraph:
